text:
Maya (People Ops): Heads up — we have a visitor (Zahara, 3pm) with a medium crate and a guitar case. Need visitor badge + a couch/seat in the lobby for a quick demo.
Tom: I'll clear the sofa by 2:40 and move my plants.
Jess: Also FYI a UPS package addressed to 'Zahara' landed at the kitchen counter, marked fragile. Not sure if it's related.
Front Desk: Package moved to `Locker 3` with a note. Front desk will print the badge when they arrive.
Maya (People Ops): Thank you. Quick ask — badge printer is printing faint. Ran `lpstat -p badge_printer` and it's showing low ribbon. If anyone has spare ribbon pack, can you drop it at reception?
Tom: I have one spare ribbon in the supply closet (shelf B). Grab it and run the normal print.
Jess: On the seating — poll: react with :one: for lobby seating, :two: for upstairs lounge.
Tom: :one:
Maya (People Ops): :one:
Jess: :two:
Front Desk: :one:
LobbyBot: Poll update — 1: 3 votes, 2: 1 vote.
Maya (People Ops): Looks like lobby wins. Also a tiny mystery: there's a small shoebox unlabelled on the counter beside the coffee tin. If it's yours please claim it by EOD or we'll put it in lost-and-found. :mag:
Tom: That one is probably mine — dropped off after the band rehearsal. I'll claim it in 10. Sorry for the suspense.
Jess: Thought it was donuts. False alarm. :donut:
Maya (People Ops): Ha — thanks. I'll stick a post-it "claimed by Tom" so Front Desk doesn't stash it.
Front Desk: Visitor badge printed and front desk notified. Visitor arrival instructions sent via calendar invite.
Maya (People Ops): Awesome, appreciate the quick responses. If anyone notices labels rubbing off on badges, send them to me and I'll reprint. :heart:
